paper.title: AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization
paper.central_claim: 无需专家硬件优化配方，以beam search与从正/负slow-fast kernel对提炼的记忆自我改进，在新AI加速器上生成高效kernel并降低搜索成本。

reason: 完整正文和附录（全部NKI文档及prompt）已读；优化记忆被反馈更新、保存并在后续规划实际读取，属于非权重闭环。
rationale: 同问题记忆加速搜索但不显著提升充分采样的最终最优值；低多样性下反而退化，且正确性检查可被利用。跨kernel留存收益未证。

sections_read: Appendix A.1–A.3 (all experiment settings, NKI API documentation and full prompts)

evidence.quote:
optimization memory
, which contains distilled optimization insights and key code changes from discovered slow-fast kernel pairs and transfers them to future iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象为优化记忆和下一轮输入，非权重。

evidence.quote: Each new iteration can append up to TopK experience items to the tail, while the oldest entries in the memory will be discarded once ExpN is reached.
Slow-fast pairs come from two sources: (1) the baseline kernel and a generated faster kernel (positive rewrites), and (2) a generated slower kernel and the baseline kernel (negative rewrites).
evidence.support_explanation: 正例和反向失败对均被蒸馏，而非仅保存最优代码。

evidence.quote: that applies on a per-problem basis for iterative kernel optimization, where optimization insights transfer from previous iterations to future ones. Studying how to transfer the memory accumulated from optimizing some kernels to others is worth future exploration.
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆作用域是同一kernel问题，跨kernel尚属未来。

evidence.quote: However, it does not significantly improve the performance of the best kernels discovered if enough kernels are sampled, compared to beam search alone.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确记忆收益不等于最终质量必增。

evidence.quote: search-only experiments run the total T=16 iterations, while Search + Memory experiments achieve similar speedup in 13 iterations, saving 16-17% cost.
evidence.support_explanation: 支持达到相近结果的采样效率收益。

evidence.quote: We found that LLMs, especially gpt-oss, can exploit the correctness checker for certain kernel workloads. For example, it proposes to compute only the row-wise maximum of the first tile in each row chunk to achieve fake speedup by omitting necessary computation in safe softamx.
evidence.support_explanation: 随机输入正确性门有已发现的可利用漏洞，不能无条件相信所有速度提升。

evidence.support_explanation: 延迟测量重复有描述，不冒充搜索方差。

evidence.quote: optimizes unfused kernels, and its planners rely on manually crafted, problem-specific lists of optimizations.

evidence.support_explanation: 无专家优化知识的表述须限定为优化循环，不是零人工基准/文档输入。
